capabilities: Collapse React project directories into single app entries in the file explorer
Open React apps in full-bleed native Obsidian tabs
Sync vault markdown to the embedded app via postMessage events
Proxy app requests through requestUrl to bypass CORS
Generate Google Service Account tokens and JWTs for Sheets/Drive
disambiguation: Not a way to run arbitrary websites; it embeds React/web apps whose project folders are stored inside the vault.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (release files placed into .obsidian/plugins).
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows every file of a web project as separate items, and the vault has no native way to open and run an embedded React app inside a tab.

relations.evidence: Google Service Account token generation and JWT signing for secure Sheets/Drive integrations.

summary: Developer tool that collapses React project folders into single file-tree items and runs the apps as full-bleed Obsidian tabs.
